text: why does the building still not have them in the test route but i see them in the building workspace
resolution: Fixed why building materials showed in the building workspace but not in /test: stamped prefab pieces were snapshots, so later prefabDefined skin edits updated the workbench preview but left already placed test-route pieces with stale/no skins. Stamped pieces now carry prefabId + prefabPieceIndex, prefabDefined refreshes skins on matching placed pieces across global/map scopes, and /test polls the shared world stream length so workbench commits trigger a re-read while the route stays mounted. Added a world-stream regression proving already stamped test-map pieces refresh front/back/sides skins. Verified build-placed 41/41 and hmsc-int bundle.
